name: Heartsworn: A Knight's Game
source:
With a stranger’s challenge on your shoulders and beautiful hosts by your side, do you have what it takes to become a great knight?


[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你肩負著一個陌生人給你的挑戰，身邊有美麗的東道主們作伴。你有本事成為一名偉大的騎士嗎？

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
